research_line: RLPD offline/recovery data action correction; no learner update in this falsification step
hypothesis: The leading RLPD curve-entry precursor is an action-side speed/braking mismatch. Replacing only the first qualifying policy action with the immutable Oracle action on that exact policy state reduces short-horizon speed without worsening lateral error or damage.

branch_contract.event_rule: current replay failed and first measured precursor is curve-entry-overspeed
branch_contract.intervention: replace one action with Oracle action from identical policy state; replay the next three logged policy actions

measured_outcome.primary: treatment minus control speed after four decisions (one branch action plus three recorded policy actions)
measured_outcome.primary_gate: speed delta <= -0.5 m/s in at least 8 of the 10 pairs
safety_gates: absolute centerline error increase <= 0.5 m in every pair
measured_outcome.decision_rule: support the narrow action-side hypothesis only if all gates pass; otherwise reject this speed/braking repair and do not add Oracle action imitation based on this result

scope.partition: already consumed RLPD G0 TRAIN cells

resource_contract.rollouts: two short prefixes per sample; each branch ends four decisions after the event
resource_contract.active_training_overlap: these G0 cells are already used by an active reused-TRAIN learner; preserve its outputs and use one low-priority thread

command: nice -n 19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m scripts.branch_oracle_policy_action
